extraction.Name: Michael Jarvis
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want the patent in fee to his three quarters of land at the time he received it; but that he was advised by the Indian Agency to take it, and he did so
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: in 1920, he sold his three quarters of land to a Mr. Scott, of Gordon, Nebraska, for $3360.00, cash
extraction.Buyer: Mr. Scott, of Gordon, Nebraska, for $3360.00, cash
extraction.Occupation/Income: works at common labor for a living; that this his only source of income
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, health good, except that he got a broken leg in 1919 when a horse fell with him, and that he was working for James Bell of Chadron, Nebraska; bothered with rheumatism in this broken leg; has a wife and a 17 year old daughter to support, the wife being sickly, the daughter having good health; finds it pretty hard to get along on what he makes; has never received any help from the County or the Government; document sworn November 17, 1928
